fact: In September 2025 the ONECI equipped the 7 mairies of the Cavally and Guémon regions with 21 computer kits for the national civil registration software, and the full deployment to 689 centres will leave 99.71 per cent connected to the national register (RNPP).
title: Côte d'Ivoire : Déploiement du logiciel d'état civil de l'ONECI dans le Cavally et le Guémon
